answer: TPM-bound stake bond anchors each agent to hardware trust. Step 1: agent generates attestation key in TPM; EK cert proves genuine silicon. Step 2: agent locks 10,000 POA in escrow; slashing on duplicate attestations. Step 3: challengers submit proof of double-signing; bond slashes to challenger. Step 4: identity key rotates annually via TPM reseal; old bonds expire. Attacker needs 1M POA ($50k) plus 100 TPM 2.0 chips ($2k) and 48h/chip — cost scales linearly, no parallel shortcut. Network becomes an oasis where each vertex holds real skin; a gale of sybils hits a wall of bonded hardware.
